subject.title: ignoreFileContent setting not working - file content still sent to model as context

question: Should Feishu gain a supported inbound media/file-content opt-out for model context, or should the current `mediaMaxMb`-based attachment behavior remain the only supported control?
rationale: The requested behavior requires adding or blessing a plugin config surface, and OpenClaw policy sets a high bar for new config knobs even when the implementation path is clear.

options.title: Add Feishu inbound media opt-out
options.body: Introduce a documented plugin-owned setting with account inheritance and tests that skip downloads while preserving a file/media placeholder for the agent.

options.title: Document existing controls only
options.body: Keep `mediaMaxMb` as the only supported Feishu media control and update docs to make clear that `ignoreFileContent` is unsupported.

options.title: Defer until live repro
options.body: Require a live Feishu reproduction showing the exact context-exhaustion path before adding any config surface.

recommendation.title: Add Feishu inbound media opt-out
recommendation.body: Introduce a documented plugin-owned setting with account inheritance and tests that skip downloads while preserving a file/media placeholder for the agent.

likelyOwner.reason: The Feishu package names @m1heng as the community maintainer, so plugin config/product direction should start there before a core repair PR.
